symptoms: White circular powdery fungal patches on young leaves and shoots
Leaf curling, distortion, and upward cupping of young foliage
White web-like fungal mycelium on cherry fruits causing unmarketable fruit
risk_factors: Warm days (21-27°C) with high relative humidity and low direct sunlight
prevention: Prune inner canopy to improve light penetration and airflow
recommended_actions: Apply sulfur, horticultural oils, or DMI fungicides starting at shuck fall
